```{r setup}
library(here)
library(knitr)

de       <- read.csv(here("results/tables/DE_amlodipine_vs_control.csv"))
hallmark <- read.csv(here("results/tables/GSEA_Hallmark.csv"))
ppp      <- read.csv(here("results/tables/GSEA_PPP_branches.csv"))

n_up   <- sum(de$diffexpressed == "Upregulated")
n_down <- sum(de$diffexpressed == "Downregulated")
tkt    <- de[which(de$symbol == "TKT"), ]
fig    <- function(name) here("results/figures", name)
```

## Background

AGS gastric adenocarcinoma cells were treated with 5 µM amlodipine or DMSO vehicle for
48 h, with three biological replicates per group
([GSE348880](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE348880)). The original
study proposed that amlodipine acts through altered pentose phosphate pathway (PPP)
activity mediated by transketolase (TKT). This report reanalyses the raw data to test that
at the transcript level.

## Sample quality

```{r}
include_graphics(fig("01_pca.png"))
```

<!-- 1–2 sentences: treatment drives PC1, replicates cluster by group. -->

## Differential expression

At padj < 0.05 and |log2FC| > 1, `r n_up` genes are upregulated and `r n_down` are
downregulated.

```{r}
include_graphics(fig("04_volcano.png"))
```

```{r}
top <- head(de[de$diffexpressed != "Not Significant",
               c("symbol", "baseMean", "log2FoldChange", "padj")], 10)
kable(top, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE, caption = "Top 10 DE genes by adjusted p-value")
```

## Pathways

```{r}
h <- hallmark[order(hallmark$NES), c("ID", "setSize", "NES", "p.adjust")]
h$ID <- sub("HALLMARK_", "", h$ID)
kable(h, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE, caption = "Significant Hallmark gene sets")
```

<!-- Interpretation: p53 activation, G2M/E2F suppression, OXPHOS. -->

## Does the data support a TKT-mediated PPP effect?

TKT is expressed at high levels (baseMean `r round(tkt$baseMean)`) and is modestly lower
after treatment (log2FC `r round(tkt$log2FoldChange, 2)`, padj `r signif(tkt$padj, 2)`).

```{r}
kable(ppp[, c("ID", "setSize", "NES", "pvalue", "core_enrichment")],
      digits = 3, row.names = FALSE, caption = "GSEA for PPP branches")
```

```{r}
include_graphics(fig("05_genes_of_interest_heatmap.png"))
```

<!-- Your conclusion: directionally consistent, not significant, protein-level evidence
     may differ. -->
